tasks.title: Build a macOS arm64 candidate
tasks.summary: Package pinned Node, runtime files and native bits and add the Actions candidate build and upload.
acceptanceChecks: Exact protected input commit and version appear in build metadata; candidate artifact identity and digest are recorded.
Actions runs build only; local packaging checks verify runtime layout and portability.

tasks.title: Implement release metadata and bootstrap trust
tasks.summary: Define bounded manifest and qualification schemas, signature verification, and pinned bootstrap distribution.
acceptanceChecks: An independently supplied bootstrap checksum is required; rejected manifest signature, target, and schema stop before archive execution.
Test and production keys and namespaces are separate.

tasks.title: Verify and stage daemon bundles
tasks.summary: Implement archive verification and extraction under a private same-volume staging directory; capture the relocated runtime pin.
acceptanceChecks: Size/digest and archive path/type/permission validation reject invalid bundles without touching active state.
Staged runtime identity includes manifest, archive and relocated file fingerprints.

tasks.title: Integrate fresh install, migration, and rollback
tasks.summary: Wire fresh and upgrade admission, compatibility checks, durable release proofs and sequence floor into managed lifecycle and recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Fresh install needs no predecessor; migrates compatible clone state and leaves unsafe predecessors untouched.
Offline recovery reads old and new journals, restores only pinned predecessor and does not lower the floor.

tests.name: Fresh activation, legacy handoff, floor and offline crash recovery

tasks.title: Qualify candidates locally
tasks.summary: Add the protected candidate signer, isolated Mac qualification procedure and evidence record.
acceptanceChecks: Local qualification uses the production verification path in its separate test trust domain; validates fresh install, migration, restart and rollback.
Evidence records all required passes and binds commit, version, manifest, run, artifact and archive.

tasks.title: Promote the exact qualified candidate
tasks.summary: Add protected promotion that signs the verified manifest and publishes the same asset as an opt-in prerelease; document recovery and key rotation.
acceptanceChecks: Promotion binds the approved protected revision, rechecks evidence/identity and rejects changed or expired assets; no rebuild or hosted tests.
Production signs identical manifest bytes; no default installer change or publication during implementation.

tests.name: Promotion controls, evidence binding and no rebuild

summary.prose: Implement an opt-in Apple Silicon build and release path, with all testing run locally and publication limited to the qualified artifact.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Local malicious-manifest, archive entry, and digest mismatch fixtures
Local workflow lint and protected-input/promotion tests
Fresh install, clone migration with state, supervisor restart, rollback after failed upgrade
Verify installed runtime needs no host Git, npm or compiler
